import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from symptoms_module import SymptomsManager, Symptom, ConsultationRequest

class TestSymptomsManager(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        self.symptoms_manager = SymptomsManager()

    def test_add_new_symptom(self):
        # Test adding a new symptom
        symptom_name = "Fever"
        symptom_description = "High body temperature"
        self.symptoms_manager.add_symptom(symptom_name, symptom_description)
        self.assertIn(symptom_name, self.symptoms_manager.symptoms)
        self.assertEqual(self.symptoms_manager.symptoms[symptom_name].description, symptom_description)

    def test_view_and_update_symptom(self):
        # Test viewing and updating an existing symptom
        symptom_name = "Cough"
        symptom_description = "Persistent coughing"
        self.symptoms_manager.add_symptom(symptom_name, symptom_description)
        updated_description = "Severe coughing"
        self.symptoms_manager.update_symptom(symptom_name, updated_description)
        self.assertEqual(self.symptoms_manager.symptoms[symptom_name].description, updated_description)

    def test_delete_symptom_no_consultation_request(self):
        # Test deleting a symptom with no consultation request
        symptom_name = "Headache"
        symptom_description = "Pain in the head"
        self.symptoms_manager.add_symptom(symptom_name, symptom_description)
        self.symptoms_manager.delete_symptom(symptom_name)
        self.assertNotIn(symptom_name, self.symptoms_manager.symptoms)

    def test_delete_symptom_with_consultation_request(self):
        # Test deleting a symptom with an existing consultation request
        symptom_name = "Nausea"
        symptom_description = "Feeling of sickness"
        self.symptoms_manager.add_symptom(symptom_name, symptom_description)
        consultation_request = ConsultationRequest(symptom_name)
        self.symptoms_manager.consultation_requests.append(consultation_request)
        with self.assertRaises(Exception) as context:
            self.symptoms_manager.delete_symptom(symptom_name)
        self.assertTrue("Cannot delete symptom as it is used in a consultation request" in str(context.exception))

    def test_add_existing_symptom(self):
        # Test adding an existing symptom
        symptom_name = "Fatigue"
        symptom_description = "Feeling very tired"
        self.symptoms_manager.add_symptom(symptom_name, symptom_description)
        with self.assertRaises(Exception) as context:
            self.symptoms_manager.add_symptom(symptom_name, symptom_description)
        self.assertTrue("Symptom already exists" in str(context.exception))

    def test_update_nonexistent_symptom(self):
        # Test updating a non-existent symptom
        symptom_name = "Dizziness"
        updated_description = "Feeling unsteady"
        with self.assertRaises(Exception) as context:
            self.symptoms_manager.update_symptom(symptom_name, updated_description)
        self.assertTrue("Symptom does not exist" in str(context.exception))

    def test_delete_nonexistent_symptom(self):
        # Test deleting a non-existent symptom
        symptom_name = "Vomiting"
        with self.assertRaises(Exception) as context:
            self.symptoms_manager.delete_symptom(symptom_name)
        self.assertTrue("Symptom does not exist" in str(context.exception))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
